firmware.title: USB Wi-Fi adapter 0.1.0
firmware.about: A USB network card for the handheld: plugged into the board's native USB port, it's usb0 at 10.77.0.2, and it joins a Wi-Fi by itself (the one saved on its setup page, else an open Stump hotspot). Flash it through the board's UART (CH343) port. First build: bench test pending.
firmware.licence: MIT; built on ESP-IDF, esp_tinyusb (Apache-2.0), TinyUSB (MIT), lwIP (BSD-3) (licenses/S3-USB-WiFi-NOTICE.txt)
